content: कोशः, -शम् (षः, -षम्) ¦ [कुश्(ष्)आधारादौ घञ् कर्तरि अच् वा <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A vessel for holding liquids, a pail. .²2 A bucket, cup. .²3 A vessel in general. .²4 A box, cupboard, drawer, trunk; <ls>Rv. 6. 47. 23</ls>; स एष कोशो वसुधानस्तस्मिन्विश्वमिदं श्रितम् <ls>Ch. Up. 3. 15. 1</ls>. .²5 A sheath, scabbard; <ls>Ki. 17. 45</ls>. .²6 A case, cover, covering. .²7 A store, mass; ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां धर्मकोशस्य गुप्तये <ls>Ms. 1. 99</ls>. .²8 A store-room. .²9 A treasury, an apartment where money is kept; <ls>Ms. 8. 419</ls>. .²10 Treasure, money, wealth; निःशेषविश्राणितकोषजातम् <ls>R. 5. 1</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab> also); कोशस्तपसः <ls>K. 45</ls>; कोशपूर्वाः सर्वारम्भाः <ls>Kau. A. 2. 8</ls>. .²11 Gold or silver wrought or unwrought. .²12 A dictionary, lexicon, vocabulary. .²13 A closed flower, bud; सुजातयोः पङ्कजकोशयोः श्रियम् <ls>R. 3. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 29</ls>; इत्थं विचिन्तयति कोशगते द्विरेफे हा हन्त हन्त नलिनीं गज उज्जहार <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²14 The stone of a fruit. .²15 A pod. .²16 A nut-meg, nut-shell. .²17 The cocoon of a silk-worm; निजलालासमायोगात्कोशं वा कोशकारकः <ls>Y. 3. 147</ls>. .²18 Vulva, the womb. .²19 An egg. .²20 A testicle or the scrotum. .²21 The penis. .²22 A ball, globe. .²23 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>) A term for the five (अन्न, प्राण, मनः, विज्ञान, आनन्द) vestures (sheaths or cases) which successively make the body, enshrining the soul. .²24 (In law) A kind of ordeal; the defendant drinks thrice of the water after some idol has been washed in it; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Y. 2. 112</ls>. .²25 A house. .²26 A cloud. .²27 The interior of a carriage. .²28 A kind of bandage or ligature (in surgery). .²29 An oath; कोशं चक्रतुरन्योन्यं सखड्गौ नृपडामरौ <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 326</ls>. .²30 The pericarp of a lotus. .²31 A piece of meat. .²32 A cup used in the ratification of a treaty of peace; देवी कोशमपाययत् <ls>Rāj. T. 7. 8</ls>, <ls n="Rāj. T. 7.">75</ls>, <ls n="Rāj. T. 7.">459</ls>, <ls n="Rāj. T. 7.">492</ls>. .{@-शी@} .({@-षी@}) .²1 A bud. .²2 A seed-vessel. .²3 The beard of corn. .²4 A shoe, sandal (पादुका).
